subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: While a feature draft is open, the system shall accept revisions to any of its parts in any round.
rationale: Nothing locks before the loop converges (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-1)
fit_criterion: A fixture draft revises each part in at least two rounds, including a PRD revision after both a tech-spec and a plan revision; zero revisions are refused for finality.
